subject: Marketplace co-sell certification — telemetry & usage evidence request
messages:
From: Samantha Jones <samantha.jones@amazon.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.example>
Cc: laura_bennett, vivek_kulkarni <vivek@redwood.example>
Date: Fri, 04 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace co-sell certification — telemetry & usage evidence request

Hi Ben,

Thanks for the update on catalog readiness. To move this listing into the co-sell certification bucket on our side we need two things from CloudOps Solutions by EOD next week: 1) a short telemetry export (sample of daily active tenants + API call counts by SKU for the last 30 days), and 2) a signed evidence packet with billing metering mapping.

I've attached the AWS checklist that outlines the required artifacts — the most common blockers are missing SKU->meter mapping and lack of a time-series sample for tenant-level usage. If CloudOps can provide a CSV or JSON sample and the one-page SKU reconciliation we can clear cert triage quickly.

If helpful I can book a 30m sync with the ISV and our marketplace PM next week.

Best,
Samantha
Marketplace Partner Manager — AWS

[Attachment: aws-marketplace-evidence-checklist.pdf (PDF, 420 KB)]

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.example>
To: Elena Martinez <elena@cloudopssolutions.com>, partners@cloudopssolutions.com
Cc: Samantha Jones <samantha.jones@amazon.com>, laura_bennett <laura@redwood.example>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek@redwood.example>
Date: Fri, 04 Sep 2027 11:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace co-sell certification — telemetry & usage evidence request

Elena / CloudOps team —

Looping you in on an AWS ask that is gating co-sell certification. Samantha needs two deliverables: the telemetry export sample (tenant-level daily active counts + API/SKU call volumes for the last 30 days) and a simple SKU-to-meter mapping doc that ties your product SKUs to AWS metering IDs.

What we can offer from Redwood: a short template (attached) that calls out the minimal fields AWS looks for, and a validation checklist we can run before handing to Samantha. Can you:
- Reply with a sample CSV/JSON (anonymized is fine) with columns: date, tenant_id (hashed ok), sku, api_calls
- Attach a one-page mapping (SKU -> meter id / unit of measure)

If there are questions about anonymization or data retention please raise them here. Laura, Vivek — can you review the mapping once CloudOps sends it so we can confirm SKU reconciliation? I also recommend a short 20m call to walk the AWS team through the telemetry schema.

Thanks —
Ben
Senior Partnerships Lead, Redwood Inference

[Attachment: evidence-request-template.xlsx (Excel, 16 KB)]

From: Elena Martinez <elena@cloudopssolutions.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.example>, Samantha Jones <samantha.jones@amazon.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.example>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek@redwood.example>
Date: Sat, 05 Sep 2027 15:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace co-sell certification — telemetry & usage evidence request

Hi Ben / Samantha —

Thanks for the clear ask. Attached are two artifacts: (1) telemetry-sample.json — a 7-day export with tenant-level event counts and SKU tagging, and (2) cloudops-usage-q3.csv, which contains aggregated meter usage for the quarter. We hashed tenant IDs and removed PII.

Quick notes:
- Our internal SKU names differ slightly from the SKU values we send to billing; we included a provisional reconciliation in the CSV header but will need Redwood's help to map to the AWS meter IDs.
- The telemetry export includes a field "event_type" we can drop if you prefer a slimmer schema.
- We can produce a 30-day export easily but wanted to run this sample first to confirm format.

If everyone is OK with the shape, we'll package a 30-day file and a signed cover letter. Happy to jump on a call — Elena (PM) and Marco (engineering lead) are available Tues/Wed next week.

Thanks,
Elena Martinez
Director of Partnerships — CloudOps Solutions

[Attachment: telemetry-sample.json (JSON, 12 KB)]
[Attachment: cloudops-usage-q3.csv (CSV, 240 KB)]

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.example>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.example>, Elena Martinez <elena@cloudopssolutions.com>, Samantha Jones <samantha.jones@amazon.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.example>
Date: Tue, 07 Sep 2027 16:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace co-sell certification — telemetry & usage evidence request

Thanks for sending the samples, Elena — the telemetry shape looks good as a start. Two quick items from the Redwood validation checklist: 

1) SKU -> meter id mapping: CloudOps should provide a one-row-per-sku table with columns: sku_display_name, sku_internal_id, billing_meter_id (AWS), unit, notes. We'll take that file and run a reconciliation script to validate totals across the sample export.

2) Time-series granularity: AWS prefers daily aggregations at tenant-level for cert review. Your 7-day sample is fine for schema validation; please provide a 30-day daily rollup CSV (date, hashed_tenant, sku, daily_calls) to complete the packet.

Action items:
- Elena / CloudOps: upload the 30-day rollup to the shared Drive folder (link below) and attach the SKU mapping file.
- Ben: I'll own the SKU reconciliation and confirm meter ID mappings; I'll share results in this thread within 48 hours of receiving the 30-day file.
- Samantha: once we confirm mapping, can you trigger the marketplace triage?

I'm scheduling a 20m sync for Wed 09/08 10:00-10:20 PT. If that works for everyone I'll send a calendar invite and a short agenda (review mapping, confirm sample format, next steps).

Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Partnerships Operations — Redwood Inference

Shared folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-marketplace-evidence
DocuSign envelope (co-sell agreement): https://docusign.example/Envelope12345
